findings.evidence: Lines 332-372 build `exact ((ConcreteCategory.comp_apply ...).symm.trans (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hπ_cl.symm μ)).trans ((ConcreteCategory.comp_apply _ _ μ).trans ...)` and `(ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hmor γU).trans rfl`. These chains break on any change to the statement shapes.
findings.fix: State `hμ_cl` and `hμ_y` as standalone lemmas about `localHomologyRestriction` and `singularHomologyToLocalHomology` for a map that factors through `M ∖ {y}`. Prove them with `simp`/`rw` and `ConcreteCategory.comp_apply`, not term-mode `.trans` chains.
findings.issue: `isZero_singularHomology_of_forall_not_isCompact_pathComponent_aux` runs about 95 lines. Two reusable facts sit inside it as long `ConcreteCategory.comp_apply`/`congr_hom` `.trans` chains: `hμ_cl` (line 332) says the image in `Hₙ(M, M ∖ closure U)` restricts to `singularHomologyToLocalHomology` at `x ∈ closure U`, and `hμ_y` (line 350) says a class pushed forward from `U` vanishes at `y ∉ closure U`.

findings.fix: Factor out one lemma: the composite `Hₖ(U) ⟶ Hₖ(M) ⟶ Hₖ(M, M ∖ closure U)` is mono for relatively compact open `U` and `n ≤ k`. Use it in both `_aux` proofs and in `mono_..._aux`.

findings.evidence: The three blocks are identical: `let E' := EuclideanSpace ℝ (ULift.{w} (Fin n))` … `let := ChartedSpace.comp E' E M`.
findings.fix: Factor it into one private helper that reduces any statement about `(E, M)` to `(EuclideanSpace ℝ (ULift (Fin n)), M)`. Alternatively, have the three public theorems share a single reduction lemma.
findings.issue: The universe-transfer setup is copied verbatim in three theorems at lines 455, 472 and 488: `E'`, `hEE'`, `L`, `singletonChartedSpace`, `ChartedSpace.comp`.

findings.fix: Use the fact that `ModuleCat.restrictScalars` is `Faithful`, so it reflects monomorphisms: conclude with `(ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).mono_of_mono_map hmono_F`. For the zero case, use the restriction-of-scalars `IsZero` reflection or `Functor.map_isZero` together with a faithful-functor argument.
findings.issue: `mono_of_mono_restrictScalars_uliftInt` ends with `rw [ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective] at hmono_F ⊢; exact hmono_F`. This works only because `restrictScalars` leaves the underlying function definitionally unchanged, and no comment says so. `isZero_of_isZero_restrictScalars_uliftInt` (line 443) relies on the same defeq for `Subsingleton`.

findings.evidence: Line 210: `change IsCompact (closure ((U.1 : Set X) ∪ (V.1 : Set X)))`.
findings.fix: Replace it with `rw [TopologicalSpace.Opens.coe_sup, closure_union]` or `simpa only [TopologicalSpace.Opens.coe_sup, closure_union] using U.2.union V.2`.
findings.issue: The `SemilatticeSup` instance uses `change IsCompact (closure ((U.1 : Set X) ∪ (V.1 : Set X)))` with no comment. It depends on `Opens.coe_sup` unfolding definitionally.
`hpc_closed` proves closedness of the path component by hand with `rw [pathComponent_eq_connectedComponent]; exact isClosed_connectedComponent`. Mathlib already has this lemma.

summary: The proofs in Noncompact.lean need restructuring: the degree-n vanishing proof is a ~95-line monolith built from hand-assembled `ConcreteCategory.comp_apply` term chains, the universe-transfer setup is repeated three times, and the change-of-rings reflection lemmas rest on undocumented definitional equality across `restrictScalars`. There is also an undocumented `change` and a hand-rolled proof of a fact Mathlib already provides.
